title: Occupancy and Residency Certification — Payment Allowance Read From the HECM Ledger on a Return Home
content:
For an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile whose passed due date is re-dated on the borrower's return home, the return allowance includes a **payment allowance**, read from the transaction history of the monitored Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) loan — its scheduled monthly payments dated on or before the handling date and less than three whole calendar months before it:

| Scheduled monthly payments disbursed in that period | Payment allowance |
|---|---|
| three or more | 7 days |
| one or two | 3 days |
| none | zero days |

A profile monitoring no HECM loan has no such payments. Whole calendar months are counted as anniversaries of the day number, a month being complete only on the same day number of a later month.
